title: I'm noticing memory, confusion, or personality changes
intro: Changes in memory, thinking, or personality can be worrying and confusing — and they're often noticed by family first.
reassurance: Bringing this into the open is an act of love, not disloyalty.

roadmap.whatsHappeningNow: Memory or judgment changes have many possible causes — some very treatable, like medication effects, dehydration, or infection.
whatMayComeNext: Treatable causes can improve if caught early; others may progress if ignored.
Managing medications, money, and daily tasks may get harder.
Decisions about supervision and support may come sooner than expected.
changesToWatchFor: Repeating questions, getting lost, or missing appointments
Sudden or rapid changes — these need prompt medical attention
howToPrepare: Ask the doctor for a memory evaluation and a medication review.
Note specific examples with dates to share with the care team.
Learn about local memory-care and caregiver support resources.
